anomalies.observed: In the CAN BUS section, the GND1 and GND2 pins of both isolated transceivers U10 and U11 are connected to GND, joining the two sides of each isolation barrier.
anomalies.expected: For the specified isolated CAN interfaces, each transceiver's GND1 and GND2 domains should remain electrically separate; the bus-side domain should use its own isolated ground.

evidence.quote: U11: GND1, GND2; U10: GND1, GND2; GND symbols are shown on both sides (CAN BUS section, sheet /, page 1).
two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller through an isolated CAN transceiver

anomalies.impact: Tying the transceiver grounds together defeats galvanic isolation, allowing ground offsets and transients on the CAN cable side to couple into the controller-side ground.

parsed.summary: The CAN transceivers' GND1 and GND2 pins appear tied to the same GND net, defeating the galvanic isolation specified for both CAN interfaces.
